project.name: Destiny OS :: Engine :: Tarot
project.description:
Rider-Waite-Smith deck structure and seeded, reproducible draws (Master Spec section 17). Deck structure and shuffle are fully specified and implemented here; Vietnamese meaning content is CONTENT_REQUIRED (research item R11) and deliberately absent from this module - it is reference data to be added later without a code change, not something to approximate now.
Framework-free, like destiny-core and destiny-engine-api: an engine has no reason to depend on Spring.
